test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The diameter of a sphere is 2 cm more than the diameter of a smaller sphere. The surface area of the larger sphere is 528 cm² more than the surface area of the smaller sphere. What is the diameter (in cm) of the larger sphere?

Take pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the larger **diameter** be D and smaller **diameter** be d.

Given: D − d = 2 and πD² − πd² = 528

π(D² − d²) = 528 ⇒ π(D − d)(D + d) = 528

(22/7) × 2 × (D + d) = 528 ⇒ D + d = 84

Adding equations: 2D = 86 ⇒ D = 43 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference in **diameters** = 2 cm

Difference in **surface areas** = 528 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr² = πd² (where d is **diameter**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e467cd743dad1f4fad97e82b3b1351b1b0f194520feef89d6199b4f1a5dd86e.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let diameter of larger sphere = D and smaller sphere = d

⇒ D = d + 2

⇒ Surface Area difference = πD² − πd² = 528

⇒ (22/7) × (D² − d²) = 528

⇒ D² − d² = (528 × 7) ÷ 22

⇒ (D − d)(D + d) = 24 × 7

⇒ 2 × (D + d) = 168

⇒ D + d = 84

⇒ (d + 2) + d = 84

⇒ 2d = 82 ⇒ d = 41 cm

⇒ D = 41 + 2 = 43 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a sphere is given by (4/3)πr³ or (1/6)πd³.

Hemisphere Properties

Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Ratio of Surface Areas

If the ratio of radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b².</p
